messages:
nisha: Quick ask — can we enable the `fast-path-cache` flag at 0.5% for prod today? Need a tiny canary to validate the new KV cache ordering. Planning 2h smoke. Guardrails: error rate, p95 latency, and success-rate on /generate endpoint.
ryan: +1 to tiny canary but want explicit metrics + stopping rules. What's baseline p95 and error rate? Also make sure we don't bucket all internal users.
alex: Config snippet I propose:
```json
{
  "flag": "fast-path-cache",
  "rollout": 0.005,
  "audience": {
    "include": ["rand(0,1)<0.005"],
    "exclude": ["internal_testing", "beta_users"]
  },
  "duration": "2h"
}
```
I'll push as canary-only toggle via toggle-service.
belinda: :eyes: please add metric names — p95_generate_ms, generate_errors_rate, embed_quality_score. Stop if generate_errors_rate > 2% for 5min OR p95_generate_ms increases by >10% vs baseline for 10min.
nisha: Agree. Also want automatic rollback if downstream SLO on search_response_time degrades >5%.
devops-bot: deploy queued by alex — jobs/flags/fast-path-cache/canary -> started at 2026-03-17T12:05Z :rocket:
ishan: Quick check from infra: ensure KV cache warmup on 10% of nodes before ramp. Otherwise cold-start noise might trigger false positives.
devex: I'll add a dashboard and alerts — linking to /dashboards/fast-path-canary (will paste URL). Also pinging the experiment service to attach experiment_id.
ryan: Stopping rules summary I want in experiment framework: windowed detection (5m,10m), require 2 consecutive windows before auto-rollback, and manual review threshold for borderline cases.
nisha: Perfect. alex, once you push, please comment the experiment_id here and @belinda @ishan @devex will monitor. :thumbsup:
alex: pushed. experiment_id=exp_20260317_fp_001. Will re-run canary if we rollback. Thanks everyone.
devops-bot: deploy succeeded on 6/60 nodes (first wave). monitoring live.
belinda: seeing no error spike yet. p95 +2% currently. monitoring :mag:
nisha: closing this thread — will post final results after 2h window. Thanks!
